facts.text: She is the PE teacher: she gets the gym permit for the clubs, opens the pool for the club's pool day and teaches 百花 water-walking there at 真里亜's request.
She teaches health as well, and is flustered when the lesson turns to 'sex education'.
She goes to the staff room for forms and meetings; the club entry forms are kept there.
Colleagues are 野村先生 and the school nurse 清水先生; to the first she speaks politely.
She drops in on the literary club room, the theatre club and the council room as their adviser, and says it is natural for an adviser to look in.
She buys her first-aid kits at the school shop, and tells 真里亜 and then 一悟 to keep it secret.
She is a regular of the infirmary and says last year she broke the visit record; she is clumsy and bruised.
She drives; she offers a lift to students and to 十川さん, and parks the car at school.
She jogs at night; she is on a run when she meets 一悟 outside the convenience store.
LIBERTY: she has a place of her own after work. The record shows no home scene, no room and no one who lives with her; nothing is said about it beyond the car she drives there in.

week.text: School day: she teaches PE and health.
At noon she buys her lunch at the shop, or eats with a student who is on her own.
After lessons she goes round the small clubs she advises: the club rooms, the theatre club, the council.
Staff meetings and forms fill some afternoons.
On a pool day she opens the pool and teaches.
In the evening she jogs and, when a student needs one, drives them home.
LIBERTY: at night she is at her own place with the day's papers and the first-aid box; the record shows nothing of it.

visit.text: On the club's overnight she brings her own pyjamas and a sleeping bag, is glad not to be forgotten and sleeps among the students; she says goodnight and tells them to rely on her.
When 百花 collapses she goes to the house, finds her recovering and asks to greet the family; that evening she phones 一悟 to tell him the doctor's word.
